narrative.narrative: INJ-04: screw torque alarm at start; motor strains and stops. ERR-I33 active. tried forced the screw with higher torque - no good (can shear the screw). Cause: unmelted plastic frozen in the barrel after a cold start. Fix: LOTO the screw drive; bring the barrel up to temp and heat soak for the full soak time; retry screw rotation at low torque; purge the barrel with a purging compound; verify the melt temp is stable. Tools: purge compound, face shield, heat-resistant gloves. OK, returned to production.
